_readme: This file drives the operational + personality sections that aren't in the ESPN data at all: the at-a-glance panel, draft countdown, rivalries, futures/ballot predictions, and tribute copy. Most of it is still placeholder prose and is HIDDEN from the live site via section_visibility below — see CONTENT_TODO.md at the repo root for what's hidden and how to turn each piece back on once it's real.

section_visibility._readme: Each flag gates one section/feature in index.html. Flip to true once the corresponding content below is real, then rerun build_site.py.

league_at_a_glance.note: Scoring/roster figures below are pulled live from the DB by build_site.py for the most recent season — this block only holds the parts ESPN doesn't expose (dates, deadlines in plain language, waiver-day habits).
league_at_a_glance.trade_deadline_text: Trades lock the Tuesday before Thanksgiving. 48-hour review window, 5 vetoes to reverse a trade.
league_at_a_glance.waiver_text: FAAB waivers, $100 budget, process runs daily. Continuous waivers, no season-long free-agent locks.
league_at_a_glance.playoff_text: Top 6 make the playoffs, seeded by record then total points. Championship is a 3-week bracket.
